title: HTTP intervention demo
prompt: How should a civic team validate ACP through a public API without depending on the browser surface?

contributions.body: An external consumer should be able to create and complete an ACP cycle through the public API.
contributions.evidenceText: Protocol legitimacy improves when the public boundary is usable.

contributions.body: The example should preserve the shared cycle model rather than inventing a separate consumer shape.
Participant views and exports should be captured as proof artifacts after release.
contributions.evidenceText: External implementers need inspectable outputs, not only success signals.

responses.body: That boundary matters because it is the only part a true adopter can rely on.
